visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A domestic short-haired cat, primarily white with dark grey patches on its head and ears, sits alertly on a light-colored wooden floor next to a white-framed window. A human hand with pale skin enters the frame from the right, extending a single index finger towards the cat's nose. Large white traditional Chinese characters appear as a centered overlay. The background shows a dimly lit wooden shelf and indoor room elements in soft focus. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as the white and grey cat opens its mouth and playfully bites the person's index finger. The cat's whiskers are long and white, and its eyes are light green. A white logo for the brand is visible in the top right corner. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the window on the left side of the frame. (3) The scene transitions to a tabby cat lying on white bedding with a colorful floral pattern. A hand points at its nose, and the cat stares directly at the camera with a neutral, slightly annoyed expression. Small white text variety captions appear above its head. The background is dark, suggesting a shaded indoor area or a room with closed blinds. (4) A tortoiseshell cat with distinctive mottled orange and black fur sits on a beige carpeted floor. It rubs its chin and cheek affectionately against the pointing finger of the human. The person then uses their fingertip to scratch under the cat's chin. The cat's eyes are large and bright green, looking upward at the camera. (5) In the final sequence, a ginger and white cat sits near a chair leg wrapped in brown sisal scratching rope. The cat peeks out from behind the post as a finger points towards its face. The background is a modern home interior with wooden floors and blurred household furniture. The video ends with a brand logo screen.
